text.text_excerpt: Love Fat Tuesday. The drinks are delicious and you can sample before you buy. The place is clean and the staff is friendly. This location is right in the Riverwalk Outlet mall so you can sip and shop or have an adult beverage as you enjoy lunch in the food court. I had the Crawgator and it was delicious. I sampled the Hurricane and the Mardi Gras Mash. They were all good but the pineapple flavor in the Crawgator pulled me in. This is a great place because it's not as busy as Bourbon Street so you can get a drink to go if you desire. That's what I did and will probably always do.

Yummy Daiquiris! I got a huge souvenir cup (I think it's 32 ounces). It was $15 and refills are $9. Good buy if you will be in town for a few days. I went every morning before heading to the quarter and every day on my way back to the hotel. It beat buying drinks everywhere! The cup kept my drink cold too! The flavors were yummy but my favorite was a strawberry and piña colada mix.

Great daiquiri flavors...I like the rum punch and peach Bellini. Undecided?? Try several samples then. I have to let it melt a bit so I don't get brain freeze though. Lol. Only complaint is this location is more expensive compared to the other locations in New Orleans. I guess connivence fee since it's in the outlets and you can sip and shop....idk. I paid $10 for a 32oz here and $8 for the same size at the other location.
